payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity + pg_blocking_pids shows a two-hop lock chain: the business request (session_afb320374d58, pid 1396, UPDATE inventory ... product_id=2) waits on transactionid for pid 1395 (session_89558a3d6372), which in turn waits on pid 1393 (session_67773b127c76). The root blocker session_67773b127c76 is 'idle in transaction' (ClientRead) after its UPDATE on inventory, holding row locks open. No evidence of large data, missing indexes (only PK exists), vacuum, or redundant indexes; query_stats show tiny tables and fast statements. Uncertainty: the observation is a single snapshot; the idle-in-transaction root blocker may have since committed, so re-check activity before acting. Resolution path: rollback the eligible project-owned root blocker session to release the lock, preserving the business request.
